thread:
Alice: FYI attaching the pen-test finding here — notes indicate a KMS alias enumeration vector + an observed customer billing spike around the same window. Requesting triage + retest and an evidence checklist. report://pen/2026-03-16 (redacted)
Ben: saw the same customer ticket. they reported 500s on generation endpoints and unexpected token billing. I pulled logs: a lot of 429s then 500s from the same client_ip. snippet:
```
2026-03-16T14:02:12Z GET /v1/generate 429 id=xyz-789
2026-03-16T14:02:15Z POST /v1/generate 500 id=xyz-790 trace=trace-123
```
Carol: thanks. two things we need immediately: CloudTrail/KMS audit logs for the time window, and the pen-test PoC showing alias discovery steps. does the report include the exact commands? we need to confirm whether this was authenticated or leveraged any presign endpoints.
Alice: report includes a short PoC. quoting:
```
# enum aliases (PoC redacted)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$API_HOST/v1/keys/aliases?prefix=kms-"
```
(we redacted the raw token in the report)
Dmitri: infra note — around 14:02 we saw autoscaler churn on dedicated pool-3 and KV cache flushes for several pods. that could explain token-level latency. logs:
```
pod/generate-3 OOMKilled at 14:01:58
pod/generate-7 restarted 14:02:05
cache: flush prefix=kms/
```
security-bot: [ALERT] policy-violation-detected incident-2026-003 opened by PenTestBot :severity=info :rule=KMS-Alias-List
Support Oncall: customer-facing: we already told customer we're investigating. they want timeline + root cause. can we repro on staging? I can run the PoC if someone gives repro steps and the right env variables.
Alice: repro steps (staging):
1) export API_HOST=https://staging-api.redwood.dev
2) use a staging token with role=user:call_generate
3) run PoC (sanitized):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN" "$API_HOST/v1/keys/aliases?limit=100"
```
Expected: 403 on staging (no list permission). Pen test claims 200 with alias names.
Ben: ran the sanitized PoC in staging at 14:30 — got 403 as expected. can't reproduce alias leak there. on prod I see 200 in the pen report but can't find matching cloudtrail entry for ListAliases. need exact request/response headers from pentester.
Carol: if they got 200 in prod, check resource-based policies, and any temporary IAM role mappings. also check KMS vs HSM-usage: was the key a customer-managed HSM key or CMK? HSM audit logs differ.
Dmitri: verified: the key in question is a CMK backed by external-HSM (CloudHSM). We have HSM rotation at 02:00 UTC; nothing else scheduled in that window. however, autoscaler churn coincident with large prefix cache flush could surface an edge-case where policy caching fell back to assume-role calls.
Alice: severity discussion: pen test rated this medium, customer escalations + billing impact argue for high. open to arguments.
Ben: from support POV — billing spike looks correlated to retry storms from client causing double-billing impressions; we haven't seen data exfil evidence yet. recommend medium until audit logs show confirmatory alias enumeration or resource policy leak.
Carol: agree with provisional medium. request: (a) full CloudTrail events for 14:00-14:10 UTC, (b) KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events, (c) any assume-role STS:AssumeRole events, (d) host-level logs for dedicated pool-3. I'll re-evaluate severity once we have that.
Alice: grabbing CloudTrail now, will paste event ids asap.
Security-bot: [UPDATE] incident-2026-003 added severity=medium (auto)
Alice: CloudTrail snippets (redacted ids):
```
eventTime: 2026-03-16T14:02:13Z eventName: ListAliases eventId: ct-0a1b2c
requestParameters: {"limit":100}
userIdentity: assumed-role/session-ops
```
Carol: ok — found a ListAliases event with assumed-role principal. that suggests an IAM role allowed list on the CMK. need to map the role to service account / deploy. can infra provide role->sa mapping?
Dmitri: role maps to infra-deploy@redwood-prod (k8s SA) via OIDC in cluster 3. this SA recently had a broad policy change in last week's deploy (PR-4521). rolling back that policy would likely block listing.
Ben: customer billing: the spike matches 14:00–14:10 and correlates to 5xx responses and retries. I've opened support ticket SUP-7842 and put the customer on accounted credits pending RCA.
Alice: pen test retest ask: pen team wants us to retest after mitigations (reduce role scope + rotate key). If we rotate key first we need to confirm no customer-facing outage. propose: restrict ListAliases to ops role only, then rotate. any objections?
Carol: +1 for restrict-first. also enable KMS logging to CloudWatch for immediate alerting on ListAliases and Decrypt. add an alert rule for more than 3 ListAliases/min from non-admin principals.
Dmitri: I'll raise PR to restrict role (infra PR-4590) and schedule a key rotation for 03:00 UTC window. estimate ~2 hours work and a deploy freeze for 15m.
Support Oncall: please add a repro run plan for pen team: staging retest (should be 403) + prod retest under shadowed logging + don't rotate until pen team confirms. pen team wants to validate remediate on prod small window.
Alice: pen team ran staging retest earlier and confirmed 403. they attempted prod retest at 15:05 (pen provided traces). pen posted these traces to the redacted report: there are three ListAliases responses returning alias list. IDs:
- ct-0a1b2c
- ct-0d3e4f
- ct-0f9a8b
Carol: we matched ct-0d3e4f to an assume-role by infra-deploy SA at 14:02:14. policy PR-4521 allowed kms:ListAliases to that role. that's the root cause. severity -> high because it's an info disclosure vector on CMKs and combined with billing impact.
Ben: support will keep customer informed. we'll escalate credits if root cause confirmed. also adding a billing reconciliation step.
Dmitri: PR-4590 merged, restricted ListAliases to ops-only. I've triggered canary deploy to dedicated pool-3. monitoring: no immediate errors, KV cache stays stable on canary.
security-bot: [ACTION] incident-2026-003 status=mitigated_by_config_change owner=Dmitri
Alice: ran pen retest after PR merge at 18:12 and pen reports: ListAliases now 403 for that principal. they couldn't reproduce alias enumeration. pen will close if audit logs show no further leakage. marking retest: FAILED to reproduce — good.
Carol: follow-ups: rotate the affected CMK on 2026-03-17 03:00 UTC, add least-priv policy to infra-deploy SA, and add automated guardrail in CI to prevent kms:* on cluster SA. I'll own the guardrail ticket SEC-232.
Ben: closing the customer loop: SUP-7842 updated. told customer: mitigation applied, retest failed, key rotation scheduled, refunds in review. they asked for timeline for final closure.
Alice: thanks all. summary for the ticket:
- root cause: PR-4521 granted kms:ListAliases to infra-deploy SA
- impact: alias disclosure + correlated retry/billing spike
- remediation: PR-4590 restricted policy, canary deployed, scheduled CMK rotation
- status: retest succeeded (no repro) pending key rotation + audit retention export
Carol: I propose severity=high -> resolved post-rotation, and update compliance docs noting alias-listing is considered data exposure. filing a vulnerability advisory to customers.
Dmitri: I'll post the infra PR link and rotation runbook in the incident timeline.
Support Oncall: noted. locking this thread until rotation completes. if anyone sees new ct events with ListAliases from non-ops principals ping oncall.
Alice: :thumbsup: closing for now, will reopen if any new evidence appears.
